about: Strength routine for the dashboard's Lifts tab. Empty until a first routine is agreed: onboarding step 3a starts the starter routine for the kit ticked on the lifting card (coach/tools/lifts.py start --kit), and when no kit was ticked the morning check-in's First lifting routine paragraph proposes one and writes it after a yes (lifts.py start, from coach/exercises.json). This file is the athlete's own: a kit update never replaces it. lift_routine: the routine; lift_block: its blocks in order; lift_ex: one row per slot (ex = the slot code shown on the page; id = the exercise in it, from coach/exercises.json); lift_rule: the rules shown under the routine. Logged sets live in the dashboard store (lift_log/<date>) and are copied to coach/strength_log.csv by the morning run. Exercises rotate between training blocks only through coach/tools/lifts.py (coach/strength_rotation.json).
